examples.en: The police caught the thief at the market.

taglish: Madilim ang eskinita, dumaan ka sa main road.
notes: Root dilim. 'Madilim na' = it's dark already. 'Maliwanag' = bright, well-lit.

examples.tl: Madilim ang daan, walang ilaw sa kalye.
examples.en: The road is dark, there are no streetlights.
examples.taglish: Madilim ang daan, walang streetlight, mag-Grab ka na lang.

examples.tl: Umuwi ka na, madilim na.
examples.en: Go home now, it's getting dark.

taglish: May aksidente sa EDSA, kaya traffic.
notes: From Spanish. 'Nabangga' = got hit / crashed. 'Banggaan' = collision. Accidents are the usual reason EDSA stops moving.

examples.tl: May aksidente sa Guadalupe, hindi umuusad ang traffic.
examples.en: There's an accident at Guadalupe, traffic isn't moving.
examples.taglish: May aksidente sa Guadalupe, hindi umuusad, 1 hour na kami.

examples.tl: Naaksidente ang kaibigan ko sa motor.
examples.en: My friend had a motorcycle accident.

taglish: Mag-isa ka lang? Ingat ka pauwi.
notes: 'Mag-isa lang ako' = I'm alone. 'Solo' also used. 'Huwag kang mag-isa doon' = don't go there alone.

examples.tl: Huwag kang maglakad mag-isa doon pag gabi.
examples.en: Don't walk there alone at night.
examples.taglish: Wag kang maglakad mag-isa doon pag gabi, delikado.

examples.tl: Mag-isa akong nag-travel sa Siargao.
examples.en: I traveled solo to Siargao.

taglish: Nakakatakot dito pag gabi, walang tao.
notes: Root takot = fear. 'Natakot ako' = I got scared. 'Takot ako' = I'm scared. 'Nakakatakot' describes the thing.

examples.tl: Nakakatakot ang eskinita pag gabi, walang ilaw.
examples.en: The alley is scary at night, there are no lights.
examples.taglish: Nakakatakot yung eskinita pag gabi, walang ilaw, walang tao.

examples.tl: Nakakatakot ang pagmamaneho ng drayber, sobrang bilis.
examples.en: The driver's driving is scary, way too fast.

taglish: Gabi na, mag-Grab ka na lang, wag jeep.
notes: 'Gabi' = night. Said to urge someone home or to take a safer ride. 'Gabing-gabi na' = it's very late.

examples.tl: Gabi na, uwi na tayo.
examples.en: It's late, let's go home.
examples.taglish: Gabi na, uwi na tayo, may pasok pa bukas.

examples.tl: Gabi na, wala nang jeep, mag-taxi na lang tayo.
examples.en: It's late, no more jeeps, let's just take a taxi.

taglish: May hatid-sundo ang hotel papuntang airport.
notes: Compound of hatid (drop off) + sundo (pick up). Used for school service vans, hotel transfers, and a partner doing the driving.

examples.tl: May hatid-sundo ang school ng anak nila.
examples.en: Their kid's school has a shuttle service.
examples.taglish: May hatid-sundo service yung school ng anak nila, 3,000 a month.

examples.tl: Ako ang hatid-sundo ng asawa ko ngayong linggo.
examples.en: I'm my wife's driver this week.

taglish: Nakarating na ako sa hotel, safe.
notes: Root dating with maka- (managed to). 'Nakauwi' = made it home. The standard 'I'm here safe' text.

examples.tl: Nakarating na kami sa Baguio, malamig.
examples.en: We've arrived in Baguio, it's cold.
examples.taglish: Nakarating na kami sa Baguio, 6 hours, ang lamig.

examples.tl: Text mo ako pag nakarating ka na ha.
examples.en: Text me when you've arrived, okay.

taglish: Nag-kalesa kami sa Intramuros, 500 for 30 mins.
notes: Tourist ride in Intramuros and Binondo. From Spanish. Agree on the price first.

examples.tl: Sumakay kami ng kalesa sa Intramuros.
examples.en: We rode a kalesa in Intramuros.
examples.taglish: Nag-kalesa kami sa Intramuros, tour na rin.

taglish: Mag-pedicab lang tayo hanggang palengke.
notes: Pedal-powered trike for short hops inside barangays. Also called 'padyak'. Cheaper and slower than a trike.

examples.tl: Sumakay kami ng pedicab mula palengke hanggang bahay.
examples.en: We took a pedicab from the market to the house.
examples.taglish: Nag-pedicab lang kami from palengke to bahay, 20 pesos.

examples.tl: Walang pedicab sa Makati CBD, bawal.
examples.en: There are no pedicabs in Makati CBD, they're banned.

taglish: Nasa labas na ang rider, kunin mo ang order.
notes: Grab/Lalamove/foodpanda delivery drivers and Angkas drivers are all 'rider'. 'Kuya rider' when talking to one.

examples.tl: Tumawag ang rider, nasa gate na siya.
examples.en: The rider called, he's at the gate.
examples.taglish: Tumawag yung rider, nasa gate na, kunin mo yung order.

examples.tl: Maraming rider ang naaksidente sa EDSA.
examples.en: Many riders get into accidents on EDSA.

taglish: Mag-load ka ng beep card, mahaba ang pila sa ticket.
notes: Stored-value card for MRT/LRT, EDSA Carousel, some buses. 'Mag-load' = top up. Also 'Tap!' at the gate.

examples.tl: Wala nang load ang beep card ko.
examples.en: My beep card is out of credit.
examples.taglish: Wala nang load yung beep card ko, mag-load muna ako sa station.

examples.tl: Mag-tap ka ng beep card sa gate.
examples.en: Tap your beep card at the gate.

taglish: Special na lang tayo, 150 hanggang Rockwell.
notes: Hiring a trike or jeep just for yourself instead of waiting to fill it. Costs more; negotiate first: 'Magkano special?'

examples.tl: Special na lang, Kuya, magkano hanggang Guadalupe?
examples.en: Private trip please, how much to Guadalupe?
examples.taglish: Special na lang, Kuya, magkano hanggang Guadalupe? 100?

examples.tl: Nag-special kami ng trike kasi gabi na.
examples.en: We hired a trike privately because it was late.

taglish: Lampas na tayo, Kuya! Mag-U-turn po.
notes: 'Lampas ng X' = past X. 'Nalampasan' = we passed it / missed the turn. 'Lumampas' = to go past.

examples.tl: Lampas ng Jollibee, kanan ka.
examples.en: Past the Jollibee, turn right.
examples.taglish: Lampas ng Jollibee, kanan ka, tapos sa tabi lang.

examples.tl: Nalampasan natin ang kanto, balik tayo.
examples.en: We passed the corner, let's go back.

taglish: Balik tayo, nakalimutan ko ang passport.
notes: Root balik. 'Babalik ako' = I'll be back. 'Pabalik' = heading back. 'Balikan' = to go back for.

examples.tl: Bumalik kami sa hotel kasi umulan.
examples.en: We went back to the hotel because it rained.
examples.taglish: Bumalik kami sa hotel kasi umulan, ang lakas.

examples.tl: Babalik ako sa Manila sa Lunes.
examples.en: I'll be back in Manila on Monday.

taglish: Umikot pa kami kasi one-way, ang hassle.
notes: Root ikot. 'Umikot' = go around / detour / circle for parking. 'Mag-ikot' = look around a place. 'Ikot' jeep = a loop route.

examples.tl: Umikot kami nang tatlong beses para makahanap ng parking.
examples.en: We circled three times to find parking.
examples.taglish: Umikot kami 3 times para makahanap ng parking sa Greenbelt.

examples.tl: Mag-ikot muna tayo sa mall bago kumain.
examples.en: Let's look around the mall first before eating.

taglish: May shortcut sa Kalayaan, iwas Makati Ave.
notes: Used as-is. 'Mag-shortcut' = take a shortcut. Waze shortcuts through eskinitas are a Manila thing.

examples.tl: May alam akong shortcut papuntang BGC.
examples.en: I know a shortcut to BGC.
examples.taglish: May alam akong shortcut papuntang BGC, via Kalayaan flyover.

examples.tl: Nag-shortcut ang Grab driver sa eskinita.
examples.en: The Grab driver took a shortcut through an alley.
